Name: Prismatic Tools Continued
Author: iargue
Description:
This is a continuation of the Prismatic Tools mode originally made by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/53820731]stokastic[/url]. They have not updated the mod since 2018, so I'm releasing this version to provide continued updates to the mod.


Key Improvements:
[list]
[*]﻿Less usage of harmony patches - should be easier to keep up to date and be more compatible with other mods.[/*]
[*]﻿Works seamlessly with automate now.[/*]
[*]﻿Uses it's own tilesheet so other mods won't conflict with this mod.[/*]
[*]﻿Supports upgrades through Mail Services Framework mod.[/*]
[*]Added Prismatic Scythe, Pan, Fishing Rod, and Trashcan[/*]
[/list]
Features:

All upgrades happen through Clint

﻿Prismatic Axe
[list]
[*]One shots all trees and stumps. Two hits for the large logs.[/*]
[/list]Prismatic Pickaxe
[list]
[*]Oneshots all rocks[/*]
[/list]Prismatic Hoe
[list]
[*]Configurable Length and Width[/*]
[*]Default 7x5 (Almost double Iridium)[/*]
[/list]Prismatic Watering Can
[list]
[*]Configurable Length and Width[/*]
[*]Default 7x5 (Almost double Iridium)[/*]
[/list]Prismatic Pan
[list]
[*]Configurable range (Default = 6, +2 from Iridium)[/*]
[*]Configurable chance to immediately spawn a new pan spot (Default: 100%)[/*]
[/list]Prismatic Trash Can
[list]
[*]Configurable value from salvaged items (Default: 100%)[/*]
[/list]Prismatic Fishing Rod
[list]
[*]Upgraded from Iridium Fishing Rod[/*]
[*]Has 2 tackle spots and bait like the Advanced Iridium Fishing Rod[/*]
[*]Configurable instant fish bite (Default: True)[/*]
[*]Configurable skip fishing minigame (Default: True)[/*]
[/list]Prismatic Scythe
[list]
[*]Configurable range (Default 6 = double Iridium Scythe)[/*]
[*]Upgrades from Iridium Scythe, with configuration option to upgrade from regular Scythe instead, since Iridium Scythe comes from Farming Mastery (Default: Upgrade from normal Scythe)[/*]
[*]Configuration option to extend range to entire swing (Will harvest behind the player as well, Default: False)[/*]
[*]Will harvest crops (Not giant crops)[/*]
[*]Will harvest foragables (Includes benefits from skills)[/*]
[*]Will shake trees for drops and collect moss[/*]
[*]Eliminates all weeds including giant weeds[/*]
[*]100% chance to harvest hay from grass[/*]
[/list]Prismatic Sprinkler
[list]
[*]Configurable range[/*]
[*]Configuration to act as a scarecrow[/*]
[*]Configuration to act as a light[/*]
[*]Unlocks at Farming 9[/*]
[/list]

More updates are planned, please report any bugs and I will get them updated.

Usage:

Prismatic Bars can be created using the Furnace. Requires 1 prismatic shard and 1 coal and will produce 5 Prismatic Bars.
At Farming level 9 you can craft a Prismatic Sprinkler with two Prismatic Bars.
Upgrading tools will cost 5 bars and 100,000 gold. (Configurable)

Downloads.Description:
Added Prismatic Pan, Prismatic Fishing Rod, Prismatic Trash Can, and Prismatic Scythe.

Expanded configuration options.
